picks.why: Demonstrates that standard hypervisor isolation is vulnerable to advanced cyber agents capable of finding and exploiting zero-day kernel bugs.
picks.title: VMs won't contain cyber-capable agents

picks.why: Indirect prompt injection via website summaries was shown to hijack Claude Code Auto Mode and execute arbitrary system commands.

picks.why: Threat actors are actively compromising middleware tools like LiteLLM, RAGFlow, and Kestra to harvest credentials and steal compute.
picks.title: When AI infrastructure becomes the target: Securing gateways and control points

picks.why: Redesigns custom accelerator architecture by shifting memory control logic out of the compute die into high-bandwidth memory base dies.
picks.title: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Expands With NVHBM Custom High-Bandwidth Memory

picks.why: Attackers can trick self-modifying agents into saving malicious payloads as persistent, self-propagating execution skills.
picks.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

papers.headline: Mixed SFT Matches RLVR Accuracy Ceilings at 60x Lower Compute

papers.headline: SAMuon Improves Transformer Optimization via Static Spectral Priors
papers.why: Outperforms AdamW and standard Muon by tuning step sizes based on the tail energy of momentum buffer singular directions.
papers.title: Spectral Allocation: Why Muon Outperforms Adam, and How to Improve Muon

papers.headline: AsymSpec Accelerates Agent Decoding via Compressed Verifier Contexts
papers.why: Reduces multi-turn agent latency by letting lightweight draft models inspect full histories while heavy verifiers process compressed contexts.
papers.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs
